suspected_cause: Network / Rate Limit vs Mutex Deadlock
detailed_findings: LocalNeuralTTSProvider._arm_idle_timer() attempted to acquire self._worker_lock while synthesize_to_wav() already held it. Because self._worker_lock was a non-reentrant threading.Lock(), the synthesis thread entered permanent futex_do_wait deadlock, causing HTTP requests to exceed client timeout.
remediation: Converted self._worker_lock and self._lock to threading.RLock(). Bounded PyTorch worker threads.
